trailhead.label: the Rauterplatz in the centre of Matrei in Osttirol, the board’s start

cautions: About 600 m on the Virgener Straße and 140 m on the Virgental road (L24) over the Brugger bridge, part of it signed 70 km/h: keep your dog close on a short lead and use the pavement.
Farm lanes near Weier and Bichl open to traffic.
The Isel is fast and cold: keep your dog out of it.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
